description: This file defines the AggregatedCachePressureMonitor class, which manages a group of cache pressure monitors, tracks their pressure status, logs status changes, and provides methods to add monitors and record cache pressure contributions.

classes.name: AggregatedCachePressureMonitor
classes.description: A monitor that aggregates multiple cache pressure monitors, tracks their overall pressure status, and logs changes.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records a cache pressure contribution across all monitors in the group.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Adds a new cache pressure monitor to the group.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Determines if any monitor in the group is currently under pressure, updates internal state, and logs status change.

methods.name: LogInfoIngestingMessagesTooFast
methods.description: Logs an information message indicating messages are ingesting too fast.

methods.name: LogInfoMessageIngestionIsHealthy
methods.description: Logs an information message indicating message ingestion is healthy.
